question: In which year did India make its Olympic debut in hockey?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1928**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India made its Olympic debut in hockey at the 1928 Amsterdam Olympics.
 
• In its debut, the Indian hockey team won the gold medal, defeating the Netherlands in the final match.
 
• The victory in 1928 marked the beginning of India’s illustrious history in Olympic hockey.
 
• India went on to dominate the sport, winning six consecutive Olympic gold medals from 1928 to 1956.
 
• Significance of 1928__
 __
 
• Established India as a formidable force in international hockey.
 
• Helped promote the sport within the country and inspired future generations of players.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• History of Indian Hockey__

 __
 
• Indian hockey gained international recognition during the British colonial era.
 
• Field hockey is considered a national sport in India, with a rich legacy of success in various tournaments.
 
 
 
• Olympic Games__
 
 
• The Olympics are held every four years, featuring a wide array of sports and countries participating.
 
• Hockey has been a prominent sport in the Olympics since its inclusion in 1908.
